lines: 4. Theſe are the generations of heauen & earth , when they were
created in the day, when our Lord God tade the heauen, and the earth,
5. and euerv plant ot the field, before it ſhot vp in the earth, and euerie
hearb of the ground before it ſprang. For our Lord God had not rayned
vpon the earth: and tnan was not to til the eatth: 6. But a ſpring roſt
out of the earth watering al the ouermoſt part of the earth. 7. Our Lord
God therfore formed man of the ſlyme ot the eattk : and (a) breathed
into his face the breath of life, & man became a liuing ſoule.
8. And our Lord God had (i) planteda Paradiſe of pleaſure tromn the
begintring: wherin he placed man whom he had tormed. 9. And our
Lord God broug ht torth of the ground al manner of trees, taite to be-
hold, and plcaſant to eate of : the tree of lite alſo in the midldle of Pata-
diſe: and the tree of knowledge of good and euil. 10. And a tiuer iflued
out of the plate of pleaſure to water Paradiſe, which from thence is di-
uided iuto toure heades. 11. The name of one is Phifon : that is it
which compaſſeth al the land of Heuilath, where gold groweth. 12. And
the gold of that land is very good : there is tound bdclium, and the ſtone
onyx. 12. And the name of the ſecond riuer is Gehon : that is it which
compaſſeth al the land ot Ethiopia. 14. And the name of the third tiuer
is Tygris: that ſame paſſeth along by the Aſſirians. And the fourth riuet,
t5. Out Lord God therfore tooke man, & put him in the Paradiſe of
pleaſure, to worke, & keepe it. 16. And he commanded him ſaying: Ot
euerie tree of Paradiſe eate thou : 17. But of the tree of knowledge of
good & euil eate thou not. For in what day ſoeuer thou ſhalt eate ot it,
thou ſhalt dye the death. 12. Our Lord God alſo ſaid : It is not good
for man to be alone: let vs make him a help like vnto himſelfe. 19. Our
Lord God therfore bauing forrned of clay al beaſts of the earth, aud fou-
les of the ayre , brought them to Adam, that he might ſee what to cal
tone ribbe, a3 if them : for al that Adam called any liuing creature , the ſame is his name,
20. And Adam called al beaſts by theit narnes, and al toules of the
avre and al cattel of the field : but vnto Adam there was not found an
thelper like himſelfe. 21. Our Lord God therfore caſt a dead ſleep vpon
Adam: and when he was faſt aſleep, he tooke one of his ribbes, & filled
vp fleſh for it. 22. And our Lord God (c) built the ribbe which he e,7.
tooke of Adam into a woman, & brought her to Adam. 22. And Adam
ſaid : This now is bone of my bones, and fleſh of my fleſh: ſhe ſual be
called woman, becauſe ſhe was taken out of man. 24. Whertore man
ſhal leaue his father & mothet, & ſhal cleaue to his wife, & thev ſhal be
(4) two in one fleſh. 25. And they were both naked, to wit Adam and
his wife : and were not aſhamed.
